authoredSetupInstructions: Straddle the loaded bar or landmine and grip the handles at your shins.
Hinge forward to about 45°, chest up, back flat, core braced.

beats.label: Stretch
beats.cue: Let your arms reach full extension.

beats.label: Hinge
beats.cue: Keep your back flat and hips still.

beats.label: Top
beats.cue: Draw the handle toward your lower chest.

beats.label: Squeeze
beats.cue: Keep elbows back and both grips closed.

beats.label: Return
beats.cue: Return to straight arms without rounding.

beats.label: Reset
beats.cue: Stay hinged; keep both feet planted.
